scope: Official PostgreSQL 18 documentation only; public reads, no provider account/API or supplier contact

sources.title: Role attributes
sources.observation: Distinguishes role creation, automatic creator ADMIN membership, SET and inheritance; only privileged grantor can remove automatic grant.

sources.title: ALTER DATABASE
sources.observation: Non-superuser ownership transfer requires CREATEDB and ability to SET ROLE to the target owner.

sources.title: ALTER ROLE
sources.observation: Role administration and role-specific session settings have distinct privilege conditions.

sources.title: REVOKE
sources.observation: Grantor/ADMIN authority controls membership revocation; a revoke command alone is not evidence membership disappeared.

sources.title: GRANT
sources.observation: SET, INHERIT and ADMIN membership options represent separate capabilities.

sources.title: ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES
sources.observation: Defaults apply to future objects under the creating role; actual session authority is material.

sources.title: ACL information functions
sources.observation: aclexplode exposes individual privileges, grantee, grantor and grantability; acldefault handles null ACL semantics.
